description: This file defines the LayerMetadataWelder class, a content display driver for managing layer metadata in OrchardCore CMS. It handles editing and updating layer metadata associated with content items.

classes.name: LayerMetadataWelder
classes.description: A content display driver that manages editing and updating layer metadata for content items in OrchardCore.

methods.name: LayerMetadataWelder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layer service and string localizer.

methods.name: BuildPrefix
methods.description: Sets the HTML field prefix for the layer metadata, defaulting to 'LayerMetadata' if none provided.

methods.name: EditAsync
methods.description: Handles the editing of layer metadata, initializing the view model with current data.

methods.name: UpdateAsync
methods.description: Processes updates to the layer metadata from the user input, validating required fields.
